questions.question: Jak curl rozdziela body, nagłówki, status HTTP i metodę HEAD?
Jak --write-out i --fail-with-body rozdzielają status HTTP od kodu wyjścia procesu?

excerpts.text: --head fetches headers only and makes curl issue an HTTP HEAD request.
--include adds response headers to the normal output together with the response body.
--write-out prints selected transfer information after completion; http_code exposes the response status code.
--fail-with-body returns error 22 for HTTP responses with status 400 or greater while preserving the response body.

sources.title: curl command line tool man page

excerpts.text: GET requests transfer a current representation; HEAD has the same semantics as GET but the server does not send content in the response.
The status code describes the result of attempting to understand and satisfy the request.
